name: EWUK World Championship
epitaph: Contested in the fed's own first-round tournament at its inaugural Wednesday Night Warriors broadcast (24 April 1997); no tournament result survives in this collection's own held record.

name: EWUK Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Defended by the Duo of Annihilation against the Moral Majority on 27 August 1997; no result survives in this collection's own held record.

name: EWUK Warriors Championship
epitaph: Billed for defense on 27 August 1997 alongside the Tag Team Championship; no result survives in this collection's own held record.
